lore: A short book for the blocks Vanilla forgot to build.
use: The Simple Blocks Guide explains the new blocks and the stairs, slabs and walls. Craft it shapeless from a book and a clay ball.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.

lore: Deepslate tiles with a muffled soul: they keep a secret like wool does.
use: Place it as a building block. A Sculk Sensor or a Warden does not hear a vibration that passes through it, and walking on it makes none.
secret: Build a silent floor over a sculk trap or around an Ancient City and sneak through without a sound.

lore: Deepslate with veins of sculk, dug out of the dark.
use: Craft it, or find it in Ancient City chests; it is never generated in the world. It is a plain building block.
secret: It sits well beside Sculk and Deepslate Tiles in a deep dark build.

lore: The cold sibling of Red Nether Bricks.
use: Place it as a building block. Stairs, slab and wall come from the crafting table or the stonecutter.
secret: Mixed with Red and plain Nether Bricks it makes striped walls and floors.

use: Craft it from six blocks of its material, or cut it in the stonecutter.
secret: It joins corners like every Vanilla stair.

use: Craft a row of three blocks of its material for six slabs, or cut it in the stonecutter.
secret: Two of them stacked make the full block again.

use: Craft it from six blocks of its material, or cut it in the stonecutter.
secret: It connects to fences, walls and solid blocks like every Vanilla wall.

lore: Bricks that have seen a few winters.
use: Smelt the plain bricks in a furnace to get the cracked variant.
secret: Break up a clean wall with a few cracked bricks and it looks old at once.

lore: Bricks the moss has already claimed.
use: Craft the plain bricks together with a Moss Block.
secret: Mossy and cracked bricks together make a convincing ruin.
